items.desc: Goh Well's journey in the scene represents the vibrant evolution of UK dance music. Since her debut through Mix Nights in 2021, she has played at beloved London venues including Fabric, Village Underground, Tola, Corsica Studios, All My Friends, Carpet Shop, Grow and Dalston Superstore, with appearances on Rinse, Balamii and a monthly residency on Foundation.FM. Her sets are charged with intense energy and soul, balancing euphoria and nostalgia as they weave through the diverse sounds of house, techno, breaks, garage, bass, dubstep, and jungle.
